dedupe_keys.name: simulated highway lane change data with uncertain vehicle parameters

description: Austrian Institute of Technology researchers publish simulated highway lane changes comparing three trajectory planners and four controllers. The free Zenodo release uses the MIT licence and contains MATLAB result files and a calculations archive. A nonlinear bicycle vehicle model is evaluated under varying manoeuvre duration, speed, vehicle parameters and odometry errors. These outputs can benchmark planning and control components in road-traffic or automated-driving simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this comparison package. Coverage is the stated numerical experiments, not recorded highway operation. Vehicle simplification and the sampled uncertainties constrain transfer to real driving conditions. MATLAB compatibility, exact internal field definitions and independent reproduction of performance claims remain unverified. No result file was downloaded or controller executed.
